title: Ocean Flow — diving equipment store
description: A bright e-commerce landing page for a dive shop. The hero is a reef with a depth gauge you drag down: the water darkens, reds fade, pressure and no-stop time update, and the store packs the kit for that depth. Featured gear with colour swatches, sizing by foot length and water temperature, a kit builder with a 10% bundle price, a working cart drawer and checkout receipt, delivery story and invented diver reviews.
features: Drag-to-dive hero driven by one motion value: water, coral colours, readouts and recommended kit change with depth
Working cart drawer with quantities, free-shipping bar, demo checkout and unfolding receipt
Colour swatches and add-to-bag buttons on every product
Fin sizing from a millimetre ruler; wetsuit choice by water temperature
Kit builder with capsule toggles, a flat-lay that springs items in and out, and a rolling bundle total
Pinned delivery story with a self-ticking checklist and flight tracker
